source: Badie research: checked against official pages (ward offices, facility management corporations)

venues.name: 불암산배드민턴장
venues.playTimes: Day entry in four sessions: 6–9 AM, 10 AM–1 PM, 2–5 PM and 6–9:50 PM. Closed over New Year's Day, Seollal and Chuseok.

venues.name: 목동문화체육센터
venues.playTimes: Adult badminton (monthly sign-up) Mon–Sat 6–8:20 AM. Closed on national holidays and Labor Day.

venues.name: 산성실내배드민턴장
venues.playTimes: Open daily 6 AM-10 PM; one ticket covers 3 hours. Closed on the 2nd and 4th Monday of each month, New Year's Day, Lunar New Year, Chuseok and Labor Day.

venues.name: 구즉국민체육센터
venues.playTimes: Badminton day passes Tue–Fri 6 AM–10 PM and Sat–Sun 6 AM–6 PM. Closed Mondays and on national holidays.

venues.name: 마곡레포츠센터
venues.playTimes: Badminton day use Mon–Fri 6 AM–10 PM and Sat 6 AM–6 PM. Closed on Sundays and public holidays.

venues.name: 서재문화체육센터
venues.playTimes: Badminton for monthly members Mon–Fri 9:30 AM–12:30 PM and 6:30–9:30 PM. Closed on the 2nd and 4th Sundays of each month (no closures in July and August).

venues.name: 독산배드민턴체육관
venues.playTimes: Day entry in sessions: weekdays 6–9 AM, 9:30 AM–12:30 PM, 2–5 PM and 6–10 PM; weekends and holidays 6–8:50 AM, 9–11:50 AM, 1–3:50 PM and 4–6:50 PM. Closed the first Monday of each month, New Year's Day, Seollal, Chuseok, May 1 and election days.

venues.name: 마상배드민턴장
venues.playTimes: Open to the public Mon–Fri 7 AM–10 PM and Sat, Sun and holidays 7 AM–6 PM. Closed the first Monday and third Tuesday of each month.

venues.name: 서대문문화체육회관
venues.playTimes: No open badminton sessions are listed. Groups can rent the main hall or the annex hall, both used for badminton, in 2-hour slots.

venues.name: 호계체육관
venues.playTimes: Badminton courts are booked in 90-minute slots Mon-Sat 9 AM-10 PM and Sun and holidays 9 AM-6 PM. Closed on the third Monday of each month.

venues.name: 성동구민종합체육센터
venues.playTimes: No open badminton sessions. Groups can rent the main hall Mon/Wed/Fri 8–10 PM, Tue/Thu 7–8 PM, Sat 5:30–7:30 PM and Sun 9 AM–5 PM. Closed on Sundays for regular programs.

venues.name: 수영구 국민체육센터
venues.playTimes: Badminton day passes Mon–Fri 12:10–2:10 PM, up to 24 people. No day passes on public holidays or center closure days.

venues.name: 동작구민체육센터
venues.playTimes: Monthly-pass badminton free play Mon–Fri 7–11:50 AM, 2 hours per entry. Group classes Mon–Thu 7–8:20 PM.

venues.name: 수원종합운동장 국민체육센터
venues.playTimes: Badminton court booking Mon-Fri 6 AM-10 PM, Sat, Sun and holidays 6 AM-5 PM.

venues.name: 송파배드민턴체육관
venues.playTimes: Four sessions daily: 6–9 AM, 9:30 AM–12:30 PM, 2–5 PM and 6:30–9:30 PM. Closed on the 2nd and 4th Mondays, New Year's Day, Seollal, Chuseok and national holidays (except Sundays).

venues.name: 한마음생활체육관
venues.playTimes: Open daily 6 AM–10 PM. Closed on the first and third Monday of each month and on New Year’s Day, Seollal, Chuseok, Buddha’s Birthday and Christmas.

venues.name: 강남스포츠문화센터
venues.playTimes: Open-play badminton for monthly members Mon–Fri 6–7:50 AM and 10–11:50 AM in the 4th-floor main gym. Closed on public holidays.

venues.name: 서구국민체육센터
venues.playTimes: Badminton Mon–Fri 9:30 AM–12 PM. Closed Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays.

venues.name: 성미산체육관
venues.playTimes: Open 6 AM–10 PM. Closed the last Monday of each month and over New Year's Day, Seollal and Chuseok.

venues.name: 연제구국민체육센터
venues.playTimes: Badminton lessons Tue–Fri 6–8 AM and 6–9 PM. Open badminton on the first and third Mondays of the month; closed on the second and fourth Mondays.

venues.name: 금호스포츠센터
venues.playTimes: Badminton day passes daily 6–8:50 AM, 10 AM–12:50 PM, 2–4:50 PM, 5–6:30 PM and 7–9:50 PM; on the 2nd and 4th Sundays 9–11:30 AM, 12–2:30 PM and 3–5:30 PM. Closed on New Year's Day, Seollal, Labor Day and Chuseok.

venues.name: 광주광역시체육회관 다목적관
venues.playTimes: Badminton Mon, Tue, Wed and Fri evenings (sessions 6–8 PM and 7–9 PM), and Sat, Sun and public holidays 9 AM–10 PM. Thursday evenings are for jokgu.

venues.name: 수원시배드민턴전용경기장
venues.playTimes: Badminton court booking Mon-Fri 6 AM-10 PM, Sat, Sun and holidays 6 AM-7 PM. Closed on the third Friday of each month.

venues.name: 사당종합체육관
venues.playTimes: Day-entry badminton Mon and Wed 6–8:50 AM and 12–6:50 PM; Tue, Thu and Fri 6 AM–9:50 PM; Sat–Sun 9 AM–12:30 PM and 1–4:50 PM. Each entry is 2 hours, first come first served.

venues.name: 강남구민체육관
venues.playTimes: Badminton classes; the building is open Mon–Fri 6 AM–10 PM and Sat 6 AM–6 PM, closed Sundays and public holidays.

venues.name: 수영구스포츠클럽(수영구민체육센터)
venues.playTimes: Open-play badminton for monthly members Mon–Fri 6–7:20 AM, 5:30–6:50 PM, 7–8:20 PM and 8:30–9:50 PM. Closed Sundays and public holidays.

venues.name: 계남다목적체육관
venues.playTimes: Day entry Mon–Sat 6–9 AM, 9:30 AM–12:30 PM, 2–5 PM and 6:30–9:30 PM; 1st and 3rd Sundays 9 AM–1 PM and 2–6 PM. Closed on the 2nd, 4th and 5th Sundays, national holidays and Labor Day.

venues.name: 백양생활체육관
venues.playTimes: Badminton day passes Mon, Tue, Thu and Fri 9 AM–4 PM, Wed 9 AM–12:30 PM, Sat–Sun 9 AM–1 PM. Closed on New Year's Day and the Seollal and Chuseok holidays.

venues.name: 송파청소년센터
venues.playTimes: No open badminton sessions. The gym, with badminton nets, can be rented any day in 2-hour blocks; ask for available times.

venues.name: 도마실국민체육센터
venues.playTimes: Badminton and table tennis drop-in Mon–Fri 6 AM–9:40 PM and Sat 6 AM–5:30 PM, one 2-hour visit per day.
